newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus auctions 22 mln pounds in 91 day bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus auctions 22 mln pounds in 91 day bills.

text.p: Cyprus's central bank will auction up to 22 million pounds ($42.25 million) in 91-day treasury bills with a March 26 issue date, the bank announced.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from March 24 to 9.00 a.m. (0700 GMT) on March 26.
Competitive bids will be accepted in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank.
Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all bids accepted by the central bank. Treasury bill auctions are held twice a month.
